summary: NuRAN Wireless filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 5, 2026 press release highlighting its transition from telecom equipment manufacturing to a Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) tower operator in Africa. The release cites 5,092 contracted towers across eight countries representing over US$900 million in estimated contractual revenue, roughly 300 operational towers, 126.44% network-generated revenue growth over twelve months, and about US$1,356 average monthly revenue per operational tower. No transaction, price, stake, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update with no U.S. equivalent special-situation event.
